---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
description: "AAK markdown review and release workflow"
---

Review markdown files with the following priority order:

1. Review all markdown files in scope.
2. Update dependencies references when documentation is outdated.
3. Add links and references for traceability.
4. Check alignment against `/Users/wso/Desktop/W3/TomWizMaster` where relevant.
5. Check integrity (headings, links, and structural consistency).
6. Check alignment of this repository to cross-repo standards.
7. Move approved information to `/Users/wso/Desktop/W3/TomWiz.io` when requested.
8. Check WSO safety/release readiness notes.
9. If content is public-facing, generate SSO TODOs and print them in terminal output.
10. Affirm completion and acknowledgment in AAK command style.

If new instructions are requested, append them here and reorder by highest to lowest priority.
11. Mark NSFW content and quarantine status explicitly in markdown asset registries.
12. Normalize gibberish media names to numeric or UUID-safe filenames and update references.
13. Keep TODO/WIP trackers synchronized with GitHub Issues.
14. Generate and sync wiki content before merge on PR review events when automation is available.
